purpose: First held-out evaluation of completed Bach pilot; no retraining or test-driven tuning
primary_metric: Music-body character NLL; PPL=exp(total NLL / total characters), EOS excluded
checkpoint_selection: Existing minimum validation body NLL; NPLM 1200, GPT A 1600, GPT B 1800. Best GPT seed B chosen using validation only.
ensemble_rule: Arithmetic mean of full probability distributions, fixed equal weights, no fitted weight

windows.target_coverage: every text character once; causal left context only; do not score PAD/BOS/EOS

uncertainty.method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap; sample family IDs with replacement, include all records in selected families; aggregate NLL over characters
uncertainty.limits: conditional on trained checkpoints and chosen split, 17 test families, no training-seed uncertainty or multiple-testing adjustment

generation.scope: 30 samples per model, fixed training-supported prompt conditions; parser acceptance, EOS, interior meter errors, length; not human musical quality

CKA.observations: body target positions from evaluation windows, maximum 1536 evenly spaced indices
CKA.scope: exploratory same-corpus seed analysis; not cross-style or proof of stitchability

forbidden: No data reassignment, checkpoint changes, retraining, ensemble fitting or sample cherry-picking after test scores

pre_test_amendment.reason: Upstream E1 code averages logits; measure both logit and probability ensemble with fixed weights before opening test scoring
pre_test_amendment.comparison_scope: same corpus seeds/architectures, not upstream waltz/reel benchmark reproduction
